dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Huh. Funny. I was sure I had it in my pocket...

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: That won't do, we were supposed to pass them to Granny Una...

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: She's grown old and can't remember a ton of things clearly anymore. Recently, she's started going on about things that happened to her when she was young.

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: She's always going on about flowers this and flowers that... She even said that they were flowers from beyond the Sea of Fog, ones that looked both different and very pretty...

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: Then one day, I had a dream. I dreamed that the fog that covered the island disappeared with a single "woosh"! And there, on the other side of the ocean, stood a tall, huge, beautiful house. It wasn't made of wood... Or made of gold...

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: Me too, me too!

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: In that dream, I scaled high mountains and climbed great trees, and gathered lots and lots of beautiful flowers. I'd never seen them in my life, but I knew that those were the ones Granny Una was looking before...

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: But the flowers were too heavy, so I fell from the tree. I fell and fell and fell... and then I woke up.

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: Hah! That'll teach you to be so greedy. I said we'd gotten enough of them already, but noooo, you didn't listen! And I ended up falling out of the tree together with you, too!

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: Well, our pockets are empty now, and the stuff's all gone... How are we going to face Granny Una like this?

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: What are we going to do...

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: Well, you think of something, will you?

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Yeah! Those are the ones! Wow-wee, they're just like the ones in my dream!

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: Thanks so much!

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: Kito, once we've gone to see Granny Una, let's head to the beach on the east side to play! You can see Shourai Shrine from over there, y'know!

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: It's Chirai Shrine, come on...

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Hello there!

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: Thanks for helping us get those flowers! Still, I've got to say that something's fishy around here...

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: Me too. I mean, it's odd, isn't it...

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: Every time we go to a different place, we always meet unhappy people... And no one can hear what anyone else is saying...

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: And every time we find a beautiful flower, pick it up, and put it in our bags, it goes missing super quick!

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: Is that so... I don't really get it.

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: We need to leave?

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: That golden man did say something like that as well... But we can't go with him yet.

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: We've still got to bring Granny Una some beautiful flowers!

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: I can't leave just yet.

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: If Kito's not leaving, I'm not leaving either!

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Thanks! We'll bring these flowers back to Granny Una!

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: Hey, Kito, give me half!

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Let's go to the other side of the mountain. There's some great places to play in the Autake Plains to the southwest!

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: Chise's gonna be so mad at us... But whatever, I wanna go too!

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Looks like we meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: Hello again!

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: Yup, still here! By the way, do you know what this big rock is used for?

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: Hehe! Kito knows everything, don'cha know?

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: I've heard Grandpa Mata say that this is a tombstone used to guide the spirits of the deceased. Lost, lingering spirits will be attracted to these big rocks, and so they'll wake up here.

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: And after they do, they'll wander the island looking for someone who can fulfill their wishes. Once they find that person, they'll grab onto them until their wishes are fulfilled and they can finally be taken away by the boatman...

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: Some of those spirits are nice... and some of them aren't that nice. And that's why those who pass by these big stones in the night have to loudly declare their name and clan!

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: After all, those who know who their ancestors can have way more confidence than some lonesome ghosts. Once they hear where you've come from, they'll slink off quietly and not bother you anymore!

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: Uh... Trouble is, you're an outsider, aren't you? I don't think you'll have any clan to announce...

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: Uh oh, that's true. What'll you do if you encounter a bad spirit?

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: ...Hehe, you know what? It'll be fine, 'cuz I'll protect you!

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: Right! That's right! I'll help scare those bad sprits away, too!

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Do the other islands have big glowing mushrooms, too?

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: Bet they don't look as nice as the ones we grow, though!

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Ooh, so you still remember! Nice, thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: Thanks a bunch!

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: We're going to the river down south to fish for some shells! See you later!

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Hey, Kina, don't wade into the river! It's dangerous!

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Hey there, we meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: Kito doesn't feel like talking much today.

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: It's... It's nothing. I'll play by myself today. Don't worry about it.

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: Well, would you look at that. He's sulking all by himself again.

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: C'mon, Kito, no need to get mad at an outsider...

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: ...Sorry. I shouldn't have been mad at you.

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: The golden man's bugging us to board the boat again... He talked about going to a shining golden place where there's no fog! I don't wanna go there! I wanna stay with Granny Una!

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: He doesn't play with us, and he never has anything interesting to say... He just keeps telling us to leave! He's so scary...

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: It's not as if we're not good at leaving or anything! We're just afraid that Granny Una will worry...

choices.text: Would you tell me what happened at least?
You don't look all that happy.

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: I'm fine. I'll be fine even if I play by myself!

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: And you're not by yourself, anyway. You've got me!

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Ooh! Thanks so much!

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: Sorry for troubling you!

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: C'mon, Kito, I know a great place where we can have an adventure! There's a mountain hollow on the north side of Mt. Senna. It's real secret and everything!

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: It's called Mt. Kanna...

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Hello there!

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: Hey!

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: Thank you, but we won't need anything this time. We're leaving soon... We're going to the land without fog.

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: We're gonna go see the big, shiny, golden house, and we're gonna ride on a boat to get there!

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: But before we go, we still need to thank you... Also, could you please pass this to Granny Una for us?

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: Place this in her hand, and she'll stop worrying and come with us!

response.speaker: Kito
response.text: We're counting on you one last time!

response.speaker: Kina
response.text: Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will these flowers do?

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: We can't leave yet...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are these the flowers you were looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: The far side of the river, hey! The golden oak is yonder, hoi! The golden... Uh, what was this other golden thing again...

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: Golden fish, maybe? I mean, they're pretty delicious!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I brought the flowers you wanted.

dialogues.speaker: Kito
dialogues.text: Do you need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Kina
dialogues.text: Did you find something awesome?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are these the flowers you were looking for?
